products.name: Retail Banking Services
products.description: Provides checking, savings, and time deposit accounts to individual customers through a network of full-service branches, mobile branches, and online platforms. Delivery requires regulated banking infrastructure and in-person and digital service channels.

products.name: Commercial and Business Banking Services
products.description: Offers deposit accounts, cash management, and specialized financial services to business, governmental, and institutional clients, delivered via branch network and relationship managers. Requires regulated infrastructure and in-person human labor.

products.name: Lending Services
products.description: Provides real estate, commercial, industrial, residential, and consumer loans, including small balance unsecured and secured loans, through physical branches and specialized divisions. Requires financial capital, underwriting, and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Wealth Management and Private Banking
products.description: Delivers private banking, wealth management, and asset management services to high-net-worth and private clients, primarily through the Private Client Solutions division and specialized teams. Requires financial expertise and regulated advisory infrastructure.

products.name: Insurance and Annuity Products
products.description: Sells nonproprietary annuities and other insurance products to customers through the CNB Insurance Agency subsidiary. Delivery involves licensed agents and compliance with insurance regulations.

products.name: Investment Securities Services
products.description: Offers investment in debt and equity securities, primarily through CNB Securities Corporation, to external customers. Involves financial capital and regulated investment activities.

products.name: Financial Education and Counseling Services
products.description: Provides free financial education, counseling, and wellness programs to individuals and small business owners, delivered through online platforms, community events, and partnerships with nonprofits. Requires digital content and in-person outreach.

products.name: Sparkling Beverages
products.description: Manufactured and distributed carbonated soft drinks, primarily under The Coca-Cola Company brands, using physical bottling plants and distribution centers. Products are packaged in bottles and cans for retail and post-mix fountain sales.

products.name: Still Beverages
products.description: Manufactured and distributed noncarbonated beverages such as bottled water, ready-to-drink tea and coffee, enhanced water, juices, sports drinks, and energy drinks, using physical production and distribution infrastructure.

products.name: Beverage Distribution Services for Third-Party Brands
products.description: Distribution and, in some cases, manufacturing of beverage brands owned by other companies (e.g., Monster Energy, Dr Pepper), leveraging the company's logistics and bottling infrastructure to deliver these products to retail and foodservice customers.

products.name: Post-Mix Fountain Syrup Sales
products.description: Production and sale of concentrated beverage syrups for use in fountain dispensers, enabling retailers to mix and serve beverages on-premise. Requires specialized manufacturing and distribution to foodservice customers.

products.name: Finished Goods Supply to Other Bottlers
products.description: Manufacture and sale of finished beverage products to other Coca-Cola bottlers under regional manufacturing agreements, utilizing the company's production facilities and logistics network.

products.name: Equipment Maintenance Services
products.description: Provision of maintenance services for beverage dispensing and refrigeration equipment used by retail and foodservice customers, leveraging in-person technical labor and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Transportation Services
products.description: Provision of transportation and logistics services related to the delivery of beverage products, utilizing the company's fleet and distribution network.

products.name: Utility Infrastructure Structures
products.description: Design, engineering, and manufacturing of steel, pre-stressed concrete, and composite structures for electrical transmission, substations, and distribution applications. These are large, engineered products requiring significant physical manufacturing and technical expertise, delivered to utility customers for grid infrastructure.

products.name: Lighting and Transportation Structures
products.description: Design, engineering, and manufacturing of steel, aluminum, wood, and composite poles and structures for lighting, traffic, and highway safety applications. Includes products for streets, highways, parking lots, public spaces, and safety barriers, requiring physical manufacturing and compliance with technical and aesthetic standards.

products.name: Coatings Services
products.description: Provision of metal finishing services such as galvanizing, painting, and powder coating to prevent corrosion and extend product lifespans. These services are delivered through specialized facilities and are sold to a wide range of industrial customers, involving regulated processes and physical infrastructure.

products.name: Telecommunications Infrastructure Products
products.description: Design, manufacture, and distribution of steel towers, poles, mounting solutions, small cell structures, concealment solutions, and PIM mitigation equipment for wireless communication networks, including 5G. Products are engineered for specific customer and site requirements and delivered to carriers, contractors, and utilities.

products.name: Solar Tracker Systems
products.description: Manufacture and integration of single-axis solar tracker systems combining steel structures, electric motors, and electronic controllers. These systems are physically installed at solar energy sites to optimize panel alignment and energy production, sold to EPC firms, developers, and utilities.

products.name: Mechanized Irrigation Equipment and Parts
products.description: Manufacture and distribution of center pivot and linear irrigation machines, corner and lateral move systems, and service parts under the Valley brand. These are large, engineered systems requiring physical manufacturing, delivered through a dealer network to agricultural customers globally.

products.name: Agricultural Technology Solutions
products.description: Provision of advanced technology products and services for precision agriculture, including remote monitoring, automation, and data analytics platforms (e.g., AgSense). These digital solutions are integrated with irrigation equipment to optimize water and energy use, delivered via cloud-based platforms and connected devices.

products.name: Tubular Products for Industrial and Agricultural Applications
products.description: Manufacture of tubular steel products primarily for industrial customers in agriculture, transportation, and steel service sectors. These are physically produced components used in various applications and distributed to external customers.

products.name: Integrated Payment Processing Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive electronic payment processing services, including debit and credit card processing, ACH processing, and digital wallet acceptance, delivered via proprietary technology and integrated into client workflow software for both consumer and business transactions.

products.name: Accounts Payable Automation Solutions
products.description: Automated accounts payable services for businesses, including virtual credit card processing and enhanced ACH, enabling clients to automate payables and streamline B2B payments through digital channels.

products.name: Clearing and Settlement Solutions (RCS Platform)
products.description: Proprietary clearing and settlement services for independent sales organizations and payment facilitators, supporting all major card brands and enabling customizable payment processing programs.

products.name: Instant Funding Solutions
products.description: Proprietary instant funding services that allow clients to transfer funds directly to consumers’ debit or prepaid cards, reducing delays associated with traditional disbursements.

products.name: Communication Solutions (Document Processing and Mailing)
products.description: Ancillary document processing and mailing services, including document printing, billing statements, image printing, and check printing, provided as a value-added service alongside payment processing.

products.name: Golf Balls
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells a full line of performance-driven golf balls under the Titleist and Pinnacle brands, including premium, performance, and price segment balls, as well as custom imprinted and recycled golf balls. Production involves proprietary R&D, advanced materials, and large-scale manufacturing facilities.

products.name: Golf Clubs, Wedges, and Putters
products.description: Designs, assembles, and sells golf clubs (drivers, fairways, hybrids, irons), wedges, and putters under the Titleist, Vokey Design, and Scotty Cameron brands, with a focus on premium materials, custom fitting, and advanced manufacturing processes.

products.name: Golf Shoes
products.description: Designs, develops, and manufactures golf shoes under the FootJoy brand, offering a wide range of styles and technical performance features, including custom options, produced using advanced material science and manufacturing techniques.

products.name: Golf Gloves
products.description: Manufactures and sells golf gloves under the FootJoy and Titleist brands, including leather, synthetic, and specialty gloves, produced in company-owned facilities with a focus on quality and performance.

products.name: Golf Apparel and Outerwear
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and markets golf apparel and outerwear under the FootJoy, Titleist (in select Asian markets), and KJUS brands, including technical performance wear for various weather conditions, produced via owned and third-party facilities.

products.name: Golf Gear and Accessories
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and sells golf gear and accessories, including golf bags, headwear, travel gear, and luxury leather goods under the Titleist, Club Glove, and Links & Kings brands, using premium materials and offering customization.

products.name: Recycled Golf Balls
products.description: Recovers, processes, and resells used golf balls through its PG Golf subsidiary, targeting the price segment and offering affordable, high-quality golf balls to retailers and consumers via online sales.

products.name: Cash Offer Home Buying and Selling
products.description: A technology-enabled service where homeowners receive a competitive cash offer for their home within 24 hours via website or mobile app, with Offerpad purchasing the home directly and managing the resale process. This involves physical acquisition, renovation, and resale of residential properties, leveraging proprietary technology and local expertise.

products.name: Renovation Services
products.description: Provision of home renovation and remodeling services to third-party businesses and homeowners, utilizing Offerpad's logistics, operations, and renovation teams to update homes for rent or sale. This service is delivered through in-person labor, project management, and supply chain coordination.

products.name: Cash Offer Marketplace
products.description: A digital marketplace platform that routes qualified cash offers from third-party buyers to homeowners, enabling sellers to receive optimized offers and facilitating home sales through contract assignment and transaction fees. This is a technology-driven, platform-based service.

products.name: Brokerage Services
products.description: Agent-led real estate brokerage services for home sellers, including pairing customers with local agents (HomePro) and enabling third-party agents to present Offerpad's cash offer as a solution. Delivered through a combination of digital platform and in-person agent expertise.

products.name: Title and Escrow Services
products.description: Provision of title and escrow closing services for real estate transactions, leveraging a national relationship with a leading title and escrow company to facilitate secure and efficient closings. This is an ancillary, transaction-based service integrated into the home sale process.

products.name: Electronic Trading Platform for Fixed Income, Equities, and Money Markets
products.description: A proprietary, scalable digital platform facilitating electronic trading of global fixed income (including government bonds, mortgage-backed securities, corporate bonds, and derivatives), equities (including ETFs), and money market instruments. Delivered via web-based and integrated solutions, supporting multiple trading protocols and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Pre-Trade and Post-Trade Data, Analytics, and Reporting Solutions
products.description: Comprehensive data and analytics services supporting the full trade lifecycle, including real-time and historical market data, pricing engines, transaction cost analysis, benchmark pricing, and regulatory reporting. Delivered digitally and integrated with client systems, supporting decision-making and compliance.

products.name: Money Market Fund and Short-Term Investment Portal (ICD Portal)
products.description: A digital portal for corporate treasury clients to research, trade, analyze, and report on money market funds and other short-term investments, including direct access to U.S. Treasuries. Delivered as a cloud-based SaaS platform with integrated analytics and reporting tools.

products.name: Market Data Licensing and Benchmark Pricing Services
products.description: Provision and licensing of real-time and end-of-day market data, reference pricing, and benchmark closing prices for fixed income and derivatives products to third parties and index providers. Delivered via direct feeds, partnerships, and digital distribution.

products.name: Digital Asset and Blockchain-Enabled Trading Solutions
products.description: Emerging digital asset trading and settlement solutions, including tokenized securities, on-chain financing, and blockchain-based protocols. Delivered through proprietary and partner technology, supporting 24/7 liquidity and integration with decentralized finance infrastructure.

products.name: Banking Services
products.description: Comprehensive commercial and retail banking services including deposit accounts, business and consumer loans, treasury management, merchant services, and digital banking, delivered through physical branches, ATMs/ITMs, and online/mobile platforms.

products.name: Residential Mortgage Banking
products.description: Origination, sale, and servicing of residential mortgage loans, including conventional, FHA, VA, and USDA loans, through a network of retail offices and digital channels, requiring regulatory approvals and compliance.

products.name: Wealth Management Services
products.description: Asset management, trust, and fiduciary services for individuals and institutions, including investment management, personal trust, IRA, and estate administration, delivered by licensed professionals and requiring regulatory oversight.

products.name: Retail Investment and Insurance Products
products.description: Offering retail investment products such as stocks, bonds, mutual funds, annuities, and life insurance through third-party partnerships, requiring licensed representatives and compliance with securities regulations.

products.name: Pool and Spa Chemicals
products.description: A wide range of proprietary and third-party chemicals, including chlorine products, pH adjusters, and filter cleaners, manufactured or packaged in-house or sourced from suppliers, sold through retail, digital, and wholesale channels for pool and spa maintenance.

products.name: Pool and Spa Equipment and Replacement Parts
products.description: Professional-grade equipment and replacement parts for pools and spas, including pumps, filters, heaters, and specialty parts, distributed through retail stores, e-commerce, and a wholesale specialty parts business.

products.name: Cleaning and Maintenance Equipment
products.description: A broad assortment of cleaning and maintenance tools and equipment, such as pool vacuums, brushes, nets, and related accessories, sold through retail and digital channels for pool and spa upkeep.

products.name: Safety, Recreational, and Fitness Products
products.description: Safety equipment (e.g., pool covers, alarms), recreational items (e.g., floats, toys), and fitness-related products for pools and spas, offered through retail and online platforms.

products.name: Water Testing and Analysis Services
products.description: Complimentary, commercial-grade in-store water testing and analysis using proprietary AccuBlue® systems, providing customized water treatment prescriptions and product recommendations to customers.

products.name: On-site Equipment Installation and Repair Services
products.description: Manufacturer-certified installation and repair services for pool and spa equipment, performed by in-field technicians for residential and commercial customers, delivered on-site.

products.name: Weekly Pool Maintenance Services
products.description: Weekly pool maintenance services, including cleaning, chemical balancing, and equipment checks, provided in select markets by trained service technicians.

products.name: Subscription-Based At-Home Water Testing (AccuBlue Home®)
products.description: A subscription service providing an app-enabled, connected water testing device (AccuBlue Home®) for at-home pool and spa water analysis, with integrated treatment plans and product ordering via mobile app.

products.name: HVAC Equipment Distribution
products.description: Distribution of residential and commercial air conditioning and heating equipment, including ducted and ductless air conditioners, gas, electric, and oil furnaces, and specialized HVAC systems. Products are sourced from major OEMs and delivered via a network of physical warehouse locations, requiring significant inventory management and logistics.

products.name: HVAC Parts and Supplies Distribution
products.description: Distribution of a wide range of HVAC parts and supplies such as replacement compressors, evaporator coils, motors, thermostats, insulation, ductwork, tools, copper tubing, and adhesives. These products are sourced from over 1,300 vendors and require warehousing and logistics for timely delivery to contractors.

products.name: Commercial Refrigeration Products Distribution
products.description: Distribution of commercial refrigeration products including condensing units, compressors, evaporators, valves, refrigerants, walk-in coolers, and ice machines for industrial and commercial applications. Products are sourced from specialized manufacturers and delivered through the company’s distribution network.

products.name: Plumbing and Bathroom Remodeling Supplies Distribution
products.description: Distribution of plumbing and bathroom remodeling supplies in a limited number of stores, involving physical inventory and logistics similar to other product lines but on a smaller scale.

products.name: Industrial Automation Hardware
products.description: Manufactured devices such as drives, motion controllers, advanced material handling equipment, safety and sensing devices, industrial components, and configured-to-order products, delivered as physical equipment for industrial automation applications.

products.name: Industrial Automation Software and Control Systems
products.description: Software and hardware platforms for control and visualization, including digital twin, simulation, information software, and network and security infrastructure, delivered as digital and embedded solutions for industrial automation.

products.name: Lifecycle and Professional Services
products.description: Consulting, engineered-to-order solutions, recurring services such as cybersecurity, safety, remote monitoring, and asset management, delivered through in-person and remote human expertise and digital tools to support customer operations throughout the product lifecycle.

products.name: Industrial Robotics and Mobile Robots
products.description: Manufactured mobile robots and automation solutions for industrial environments, delivered as physical robotic systems integrated into customer operations.

products.name: In-Flight Connectivity Services
products.description: Provides broadband and narrowband in-flight internet connectivity for business and military/government aviation customers using a combination of air-to-ground (ATG), low earth orbit (LEO), and geostationary earth orbit (GEO) satellite networks. Delivered via proprietary and partner networks, requiring specialized airborne equipment and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: In-Flight Connectivity Hardware and Systems
products.description: Designs, assembles, and sells airborne connectivity hardware such as AVANCE platforms, Gogo Galileo ESA antennas, Plane Simple terminals, Satcom Direct Router (SDR), and related equipment for installation on business and government aircraft. Hardware is aviation-certified and manufactured in-house or by third parties to Gogo's specifications.

products.name: In-Flight Service Plans and Ancillary Services
products.description: Offers a variety of service plans for in-flight connectivity, including unlimited and metered data, voice rates, inflight entertainment, and other features, generally sold on a per-aircraft per-month basis. Includes ancillary software services such as FlightDeck Freedom and SD Pro for operational analytics and management.

products.name: Satellite Voice, Data, and Video Services for Government and Military
products.description: Provides turnkey satellite-based voice, data, and video connectivity solutions for military and government customers on land, sea, and air, integrating commercial and proprietary technologies to deliver secure, mission-tailored communications. Delivered via contracts with U.S. and international government agencies.

products.name: Aftermarket Equipment Sales and Support
products.description: Sells connectivity hardware and systems through a global network of certified dealers and provides installation, maintenance, and technical support services for business and government aviation customers. Includes support for OEMs and aftermarket upgrades.

products.name: Advanced Electronics Materials and Components
products.description: High-performance circuit materials, ceramic substrate materials, busbars, and cooling solutions manufactured for use in EV/HEV, automotive, aerospace and defense, renewable energy, wireless infrastructure, mass transit, industrial, connected devices, and wired infrastructure applications. These products are physically manufactured and sold globally to fabricators, distributors, and OEMs.

products.name: Engineered Elastomeric Material Solutions
products.description: Polyurethane, silicone, polytetrafluoroethylene, and ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene materials engineered for cushioning, gasketing, sealing, vibration management, wire and cable protection, electrical insulation, conduction and shielding, hose and belt protection, and venting. These materials are physically manufactured and sold globally to converters, distributors, and OEMs for use in EV/HEV, industrial, electronics, automotive, mass transit, aerospace, defense, footwear, impact mitigation, and medical markets.

products.name: Industrial Elastomer Components and Floats
products.description: Elastomer components and elastomer floats manufactured for level sensing in fuel tanks, motors, and storage tanks, as well as other general industrial and automotive applications. These are physically produced and sold under specific trade names to external customers.

products.name: Mobile Services
products.description: Provision of mobile voice and data services, including prepaid and postpaid plans, over owned LTE and 5G wireless networks. Delivered via physical network infrastructure and licensed spectrum, with handset sales and value-added services.

products.name: Broadband Internet Services
products.description: High-speed fixed broadband internet access for residential and business customers, delivered primarily over HFC and FTTH networks, with multiple speed tiers and value-added features such as WiFi gateways and security services.

products.name: Video Services
products.description: Digital video and pay television services, including linear channels, video-on-demand, DVR, and integrated OTT streaming, delivered over HFC and FTTH networks and via mobile apps. Includes management of proprietary and joint-venture channels in select markets.

products.name: Fixed-Line Telephony Services
products.description: Provision of fixed-line voice services (circuit-switched and VoIP) for residential and business customers, delivered over HFC and FTTH infrastructure, covering domestic and international calling.

products.name: Enterprise Connectivity and Managed Services
products.description: Enterprise-grade connectivity solutions including internet access, WAN, MPLS, SDWAN, managed WiFi, network security, unified communications, and cloud-based IT solutions, delivered over extensive fixed and mobile infrastructure to businesses and government agencies.

products.name: Wholesale and Carrier Services
products.description: Wholesale connectivity and capacity services, including point-to-point, clear channel broadband, IP transit, and local network services, provided to telecommunications carriers, ISPs, and large organizations over subsea and terrestrial fiber optic cable networks.

products.name: Companion Animal Medicines and Vaccines
products.description: Pharmaceuticals and biological preparations for dogs, cats, and horses, including parasiticides, vaccines, dermatology, anti-infectives, pain and sedation, and other therapeutics. These products are manufactured in-house or by contract manufacturers and delivered primarily via veterinarians and distributors.

products.name: Livestock Medicines and Vaccines
products.description: Pharmaceuticals and vaccines for cattle, swine, poultry, fish, and sheep, including parasiticides, vaccines, anti-infectives, and other therapeutics. Products are manufactured and distributed globally to veterinarians and livestock producers to support animal health and food production.

products.name: Animal Health Diagnostics
products.description: Diagnostic instruments, consumables, and services for veterinary use, including benchtop analyzers, point-of-care devices, rapid tests, reference laboratory kits, and AI-powered platforms. Products are manufactured and delivered to clinics and laboratories for in-clinic and reference testing.

products.name: Biodevices for Animal Health
products.description: Devices and equipment designed for animal health applications, including delivery systems and monitoring tools. These are manufactured and sold to veterinarians and producers to support animal care and treatment.

products.name: Genetic Testing and Precision Animal Health
products.description: Genetic tests and analytics for companion animals, providing early health risk assessments and precision health solutions. Delivered digitally or via laboratory services to pet owners and veterinarians.

products.name: Aquatic Health Products
products.description: Vaccines and therapeutics for fish and other aquatic species, focused on disease prevention and treatment to improve animal welfare and food safety. Manufactured and distributed globally, primarily through the Pharmaq business unit.

products.name: Contract Manufacturing Services (Client Supply Services)
products.description: Contract manufacturing of animal health products for third parties, leveraging Zoetis' manufacturing network and quality systems. Services are provided to external clients in the animal health industry.

products.name: Human Health Diagnostics Products
products.description: Human in vitro diagnostic devices and related products, manufactured and sold primarily as a result of the Abaxis acquisition. These products are regulated and sold to human healthcare providers.

products.name: Homesite Option Platform
products.description: Millrose acquires, develops, and holds residential land, then sells finished homesites to homebuilders via option contracts with predetermined costs and takedown schedules. The company funds horizontal development (infrastructure, grading, utilities, etc.) and recycles capital as homesites are sold. Delivery is physical, requiring significant financial capital and operational management.

products.name: Development Loans Secured by Residential Property
products.description: Millrose originates and manages loans secured by residential development projects, providing capital to homebuilders and developers. These loans are structured with credit protections and are monitored through underwriting, site inspections, and compliance checks. Delivery is financial, requiring capital and risk management expertise.

products.name: Renewable Natural Gas (RNG)
products.description: Pipeline-quality renewable natural gas produced by processing biogas from landfills and agricultural waste (e.g., dairy and swine farms) using technologies such as pressure swing absorption, membrane filtration, and solvent scrubbing. RNG is delivered via pipeline for use as transportation fuel, utility gas, or for power generation, and is sold under various term agreements.

products.name: Renewable Electricity
products.description: Electricity generated from biogas using gas-fueled engines or turbine-driven generators at landfill and agricultural sites. The electricity is sold as a commodity under long-term contracts to utilities and other creditworthy counterparties, often bundled with environmental attributes such as RECs.

products.name: Environmental Attributes (RINs, LCFS Credits, RECs)
products.description: Sale of environmental credits generated from RNG and renewable electricity production, including Renewable Identification Numbers (RINs), Low Carbon Fuel Standard (LCFS) credits, and Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs). These are monetized under federal and state renewable energy programs and can be sold separately from the underlying fuel or electricity.

products.name: Organic Fertilizer Alternatives
products.description: Micronutrient organic fertilizer alternatives produced by refining and recycling swine waste and other agricultural byproducts through proprietary processes. These are sold as high-quality organic fertilizers to external customers.

products.name: Value-Added Biogas Project Services
products.description: Engineering, construction, management, operations, and environmental attribute management services provided to biogas site partners and third parties, leveraging vertically integrated capabilities developed over decades of RNG project experience.

products.name: Frozen Beverages and Food
products.description: Manufacture and distribution of ready-to-drink and ready-to-blend frozen beverages and food, including smoothies, shakes, frappes, and juice pops, delivered in various packaging formats (bottled, cartons, bulk concentrate, single-serve packs) primarily to institutional customers such as schools and military bases. Production involves both in-house manufacturing and contract manufacturing, with products meeting USDA school meal program requirements.

products.name: Raw and Processed Milk
products.description: Production and direct sale of raw and processed milk, primarily through the acquired Arps Dairy facility, to a single significant external customer. This involves regulated dairy processing and compliance with federal and state food safety and environmental standards.

products.name: Natural Gas Distribution Services
products.description: Regulated purchase, distribution, and retail sale of natural gas to residential, commercial, and industrial customers in Missouri, Alabama, Mississippi, and Gulf Coast regions. Delivered via company-owned pipeline and distribution infrastructure, subject to state utility regulation.

products.name: Natural Gas Transportation Services
products.description: Transportation of natural gas for large commercial and industrial customers who procure their own gas, using Spire's regulated pipeline and distribution systems for a transportation fee. Requires regulated infrastructure and compliance with tariffs.

products.name: Natural Gas Marketing Services
products.description: Procurement, marketing, and physical delivery of natural gas and related services to wholesale and large retail customers across the U.S., leveraging commodity contracts, transportation, storage, and risk management expertise. Delivered through digital and contractual arrangements.

products.name: Natural Gas Pipeline Transportation Services (Midstream)
products.description: Operation of interstate and intrastate natural gas pipelines providing transportation services to utilities, municipalities, and other large customers. Involves regulated, physical infrastructure under FERC and state oversight.

products.name: Natural Gas Storage Services (Midstream)
products.description: Provision of underground natural gas storage capacity and related services to utilities, marketers, and other customers, using company-owned storage fields and facilities. Regulated by FERC or state authorities.

products.name: Propane Pipeline Operation Services
products.description: Operation of a propane pipeline, providing transportation services for propane to external customers. Involves regulated, physical pipeline infrastructure.

products.name: Telehealth Consultation Services
products.description: Digital platform connecting patients to licensed healthcare professionals for telehealth consultations, including personalized treatment plans and ongoing clinical management, delivered via web and mobile applications.

products.name: Prescription Medication Fulfillment
products.description: Provision and fulfillment of prescription medications, including generic, brand-name, and compounded drugs, through wholly-owned and partner pharmacies, with online ordering and delivery.

products.name: Over-the-Counter Health and Wellness Products
products.description: Sale of non-prescription drug and device products, cosmetics, and dietary supplements focused on general wellness, skincare, sexual health, and hair care, offered online and through retail partnerships.

products.name: Laboratory Testing Services
products.description: Comprehensive laboratory testing services to measure a broad set of biomarkers, supporting health assessment, early risk identification, and ongoing clinical management, with at-home sample collection kits and digital result delivery.

products.name: Digital Health and Wellness Content and Community
products.description: Access to educational programs, wellness content, and community support via mobile applications and websites, promoting lifelong health and wellness through digital engagement.

products.name: Architectural Aluminum Framing Systems
products.description: Designs, engineers, fabricates, and finishes aluminum window, curtainwall, storefront, and entrance systems for non-residential construction, involving physical manufacturing and finishing of metal components.

products.name: Architectural Glass Products
products.description: Cuts, treats, coats, and fabricates high-performance glass, including insulating, laminated, and monolithic units, for use in custom window and wall systems, requiring specialized glass processing and coating technologies.

products.name: Architectural Façade Services
products.description: Provides integrated design, engineering, fabrication, project management, and field installation services for curtainwall and other façade-related systems, delivered through in-person technical and installation labor.

products.name: High-Performance Coated Materials and Surfaces
products.description: Develops and manufactures high-performance coated materials for applications such as wall decor, museums, graphic design, digital displays, architectural interiors, and industrial flooring, using proprietary formulations and coating processes in vertically integrated manufacturing.

products.name: Digital Asset Investment and Treasury Services
products.description: The company acquires, holds, and manages digital assets—primarily the SKY token—using a capital allocation strategy to participate in protocol-level economics and potential capital appreciation. This involves financial capital, digital wallets, and regulated custodial infrastructure, with assets held for long-term exposure and periodically monetized for liquidity.

products.name: Investor Real Estate Loans
products.description: Origination and management of loans secured by 1-4 unit residential rental properties, multi-family, mixed use, and commercial properties, delivered nationwide through a network of mortgage brokers and direct borrower relationships. These loans are primarily fully-amortizing, fixed-rate, and require physical underwriting and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Short-Term Interest-Only Real Estate Loans
products.description: Origination of short-term, interest-only loans for acquiring, repositioning, or improving 1-4 unit residential investment properties, including products that allow borrower draws for property rehabilitation. These are interim financing solutions delivered through broker and direct channels.

products.name: Government-Insured FHA Mortgage Financing
products.description: Origination and servicing of government-insured Federal Housing Administration (FHA) mortgage loans for multifamily housing, senior housing, and long-term care/assisted living facilities, delivered through a borrower-direct origination channel and in-house servicing platform. Requires regulatory licensing and compliance as a Ginnie Mae issuer/servicer.

products.name: Animal Health Products (MFAs, Antibacterials, Anticoccidials, Anthelmintics, Processing Aids)
products.description: Manufactures and markets medicated feed additives (MFAs), antibacterials, anticoccidials, anthelmintics, and related products for food and companion animals, as well as processing aids for the ethanol fermentation industry. These products are produced through chemical synthesis, fermentation, and formulation at company-owned and contract manufacturing facilities, and are distributed globally.

products.name: Nutritional Specialty Products
products.description: Develops, manufactures, and markets proprietary and non-proprietary nutritional specialty products that enhance animal nutrition, immune function, and digestive health for livestock and companion animals. These products are produced through applied research, collaboration with universities, and commercial trials, and are distributed globally.

products.name: Animal Vaccines and Vaccine Adjuvants
products.description: Develops, manufactures, and markets fully licensed and autogenous vaccines and vaccine adjuvants for poultry, swine, cattle, aquaculture, and companion animals. Production includes both proprietary and custom vaccines, as well as adjuvants for animal vaccine manufacturers, with manufacturing facilities in multiple countries.

products.name: Mineral Nutrition Products
products.description: Manufactures and markets a broad range of inorganic and organic trace mineral products (e.g., zinc, manganese, copper, iron, selenium) for fortifying animal diets and maintaining optimal health. Production is focused in North America and involves both proprietary and commodity-based formulations.

products.name: Performance Products (Specialty Ingredients for Personal Care, Industrial Chemical, and Catalyst Industries)
products.description: Manufactures and markets specialty chemical ingredients for use in the personal care, industrial chemical, and chemical catalyst industries, primarily in the United States. These products are produced at dedicated facilities and sold directly to industrial customers.

products.name: Companion Animal Health Products
products.description: Develops, manufactures, and markets health products for companion animals, including joint care supplements and a pipeline of treatments for diseases and pain management in dogs. These products are distributed through veterinary channels and are an area of ongoing investment and development.

products.name: Private Mortgage Insurance
products.description: Insurance coverage provided on residential first-lien mortgage loans in the U.S., protecting lenders and investors against losses from borrower defaults. Delivered through regulated insurance entities, requiring underwriting, risk assessment, and compliance with GSE and state regulations.

products.name: Reinsurance Services
products.description: Reinsurance of U.S. mortgage risk, GSE credit risk transfer, and other property and casualty risks for third-party insurers and reinsurers, primarily through a Bermuda-based subsidiary. Involves underwriting, risk management, and participation in global reinsurance markets including Lloyd's of London.

products.name: Title Insurance Products
products.description: Insurance policies protecting real estate owners and lenders against defects in title, delivered directly and through a network of agents. Requires title searches, underwriting, and regulatory compliance, and is essential for most U.S. real estate transactions.

products.name: Title and Settlement Services
products.description: Services supporting the closing of real estate transactions, including title searches, escrow, and settlement, provided directly or via agents. Involves in-person and digital processes to ensure secure transfer of property and funds.

products.name: Contract Underwriting Services
products.description: Assessment of mortgage applications for compliance with customer underwriting guidelines, offered on a limited basis. Involves human expertise and indemnification for underwriting errors, supporting both insured and uninsured loans.

products.name: Waste Collection Services
products.description: Collection of residential, small-container (commercial), and large-container (industrial and construction) waste and recyclables, using a large fleet of collection vehicles. Services are provided under contracts with municipalities, businesses, and individual customers, and involve curbside pickup, container rental, and event-driven temporary services.

products.name: Transfer Station Services
products.description: Operation of transfer stations where collected waste and recyclables are consolidated, compacted, and transferred to disposal sites or recycling centers. These facilities serve both Republic's own collection operations and third-party haulers, generating revenue through tipping or disposal fees.

products.name: Recycling Processing Services
products.description: Processing and sale of recyclable materials (fiber, metals, plastics, glass, organics) at owned or operated recycling centers, including advanced sorting and material recovery technologies. Includes organics processing and the production of recycled commodities for resale.

products.name: Landfill Services
products.description: Operation of active landfills for the disposal of non-hazardous and special waste, including utility ash, asbestos, and contaminated soils. Services include charging tipping fees to third parties and managing landfill capacity and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Environmental Solutions Services
products.description: Comprehensive environmental services including collection, treatment, consolidation, disposal, and recycling of hazardous and non-hazardous waste; field and industrial services; equipment rental; emergency response; and in-plant services for industrial, petrochemical, and government clients. Delivered via specialized facilities and trained personnel.

products.name: Hazardous and Industrial Waste Treatment & Disposal
products.description: Treatment, recycling, and disposal of hazardous and non-hazardous industrial wastes at specialized facilities, including hazardous waste landfills, deep injection wells, salt water disposal wells, and industrial wastewater treatment plants. Includes thermal desorption and recovery of oil and metals from waste streams.

products.name: Field and Industrial Services
products.description: On-site specialty waste management services for industrial and commercial clients, including industrial cleaning, maintenance, lab pack, site remediation, equipment cleaning, specialty equipment rental, transportation, and emergency response. Delivered by trained staff and a network of service centers.

products.name: Plastics Circularity and Polymer Products
products.description: Production of high-quality recycled plastics (PET, HDPE, PP) for consumer packaging through integrated Polymer Centers and joint ventures (Blue Polymers), including custom-blended and compounded resins for food-grade and non-food-grade applications. Involves advanced sorting, processing, and manufacturing.

products.name: Landfill Gas-to-Energy and Renewable Energy Services
products.description: Development and operation (directly or via third parties) of landfill gas-to-energy projects, converting landfill gas into renewable natural gas or electricity. Includes hosting solar projects at landfill sites to generate clean energy for local communities.

products.name: Metallurgical Coal Products
products.description: Metallurgical coal is mined from underground and surface mines, processed in preparation plants to remove impurities, and shipped primarily by rail and export terminal to domestic and international steel and coke producers. The company produces various grades (High-Vol. A, High-Vol. B, Mid-Vol., Low-Vol.) to meet customer specifications.

products.name: Thermal Coal Products
products.description: Thermal coal is produced as a byproduct of mining operations, processed in preparation plants, and sold primarily to large utilities and industrial customers for electricity generation and industrial use, both domestically and internationally.

products.name: Coal Blending, Processing, and Resale Services
products.description: The company purchases coal from third-party producers, blends it with its own production, processes it at company-owned preparation plants and loadout facilities, and resells it to customers to meet specific quality requirements.

products.name: Commercial and Consumer Banking Services
products.description: Provides a full range of deposit accounts, checking, savings, and lending products to both businesses and individuals, delivered through physical branches and advanced digital banking platforms. Requires regulated infrastructure, financial capital, and in-person and digital service delivery.

products.name: Wealth Management Services
products.description: Offers investment management, financial planning, and trust services to customers, utilizing licensed professionals and digital tools. Delivered through in-person advisors and digital channels, subject to regulatory oversight.

products.name: Mortgage Services
products.description: Provides residential and commercial mortgage lending, including origination and servicing, requiring specialized underwriting, regulatory compliance, and both digital and in-person delivery.

products.name: Insurance Services
products.description: Offers a range of insurance products to customers, facilitated through a wholly-owned insurance subsidiary and partnerships, requiring licensed agents and regulatory compliance.

products.name: Branded Apparel
products.description: Design, licensing, and marketing of men's, women's, and children's apparel under owned and co-branded lifestyle brands, produced by licensees and sold through interactive television, e-commerce, and retail channels.

products.name: Footwear and Accessories
products.description: Licensing and marketing of branded footwear and fashion accessories, including bags and related items, produced by licensees and distributed via omni-channel retail, e-commerce, and interactive television.

products.name: Fine Jewelry
products.description: Licensing and marketing of luxury fine jewelry collections, primarily under the Judith Ripka brand, featuring precious metals and gemstones, produced by licensees and sold through interactive television and e-commerce.

products.name: Home Goods and Collectibles
products.description: Licensing and marketing of branded home goods, decor, and collectibles, including handwoven baskets and home accessories, produced by licensees and sold via e-commerce, live streaming, and retail channels.

products.name: Pet Products
products.description: Development and licensing of branded pet products, including toys and training tools, produced by partners and distributed through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Kitchenware and Baking Tools
products.description: Development and licensing of branded kitchenware and baking tools for home cooks, produced by partners and distributed through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Packaged Food Products
products.description: Licensing and marketing of branded packaged food products inspired by Latin cooking, produced by partners and distributed through television shopping and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Hunting and Shooting Sports Products
products.description: Includes firearms, ammunition, archery equipment, reloading supplies, shooting gear, and related accessories. These products are sourced from major brands and require compliance with federal and state regulations. Sold through physical stores and e-commerce with in-store pickup due to regulatory restrictions.

products.name: Fishing Products
products.description: Comprises bait, fishing rods, reels, lures, tackle, electronics, fly fishing gear, marine accessories, and small boats. Products are tailored for various fishing types and delivered through stores and e-commerce, with some live bait and licenses available only in-store.

products.name: Camping Equipment
products.description: Includes tents, sleeping bags, backpacks, outdoor cooking equipment, coolers, canoes, kayaks, and camp essentials. Products are sourced from well-known brands and sold through retail stores and online, requiring physical inventory and distribution.

products.name: Apparel
products.description: Outdoor and technical apparel including camouflage, jackets, outerwear, sportswear, technical gear, and work wear. Products are sourced from major brands and private labels, designed for performance in outdoor activities, and sold in stores and online.

products.name: Footwear
products.description: Technical and casual footwear such as hiking boots, trail shoes, waders, work boots, and sport sandals. Products are selected for performance features and sold through stores and e-commerce.

products.name: Optics, Electronics, and Accessories
products.description: Includes binoculars, spotting scopes, rangefinders, GPS devices, two-way radios, knives, lighting, bear spray, and other outdoor accessories. Products supplement core equipment and are sold in stores and online.

products.name: Consumable Outdoor Supplies
products.description: Consumables such as ammunition, bait, cleaning supplies, food, lures, propane, and reloading supplies. These are replenishment items driving repeat visits, sold in stores and online where permitted by regulation.

products.name: Value-Added Technical Services
products.description: In-store services such as gunsmithing, firearm service plans, archery technician services, fishing-reel line winding, scope mounting, bore sighting, and cleaning services. Delivered by trained staff in physical locations.

products.name: Hunting and Fishing Licenses
products.description: Issuance of hunting and fishing licenses as a service to customers, available in all stores and sometimes online, subject to state regulations.
